face.name: Clear faces
face.help: Big faces in the photo, and several people together.

frontal.name: Looking at the camera
frontal.help: Faces from the front rather than in profile.

fav.name: Immich favorites
fav.help: The ones you starred in Immich.

eyes_closed.name: Eyes closed
eyes_closed.help: Pushes them down. “More” pushes them further.

blurry.name: Blurry
blurry.help: Shaky or blurry faces. “More” pushes them further down.

quality.name: Screenshots and documents
quality.help: Screenshots, memes, paperwork. “More” pushes them further down.

lyric.name: Matches the line
lyric.help: How much the photo looks like what that line says.

concept.name: Things it names
concept.help: The line mentions beach, snow, cake…: photos that show it.

tag.name: Objects it names
tag.help: The photo's tags include something the line names.

person.name: Who it names
person.help: The line names someone and they're in the photo.

place.name: The place it names
place.help: The line names the photo's town, province or country.

month.name: The month it names
month.help: The line names a month: photos from that month.

season.name: The season it names
season.help: The line names a season: photos from those months.

album.name: In the project's album
album.help: Photos from the Immich album chosen in ② Photos.

stranger.name: Only other people
stranger.help: Photos with only people who aren't the project's. “More” pushes them further down.

tuning.title: This project's settings
tuning.intro: Only for this project, on top of the general ones (what's learned and <link>your settings for all</link>). For example, in a video of old photos, less “Blurry”. You'll see it in “Change photo” and when you suggest again.

page.title: How it picks the photos
page.intro: What it learns from your changes is how you choose: whether smiles or lyrics weigh more, whether you mind blurry photos. That applies to every project. What the photos are about (summer, snow, beach) belongs to each project: the theme, the dates and “Avoid”, in ② Photos.

status.title: What it has learned
status.few_one: {{count}} correction: it starts adjusting at 20. Until then, it uses the factory weights.
status.few_other: {{count}} corrections: it starts adjusting at 20. Until then, it uses the factory weights.
status.accuracy: With {{n}} corrections, on ones it hasn't seen, it matches your choice {{learned}}% of the time, versus {{def}}% with the factory weights.
status.notInUse: It's only used if it improves by 5 points or more, so the factory weights are in use for now.
status.updated: Last time: {{date}}. It readjusts on its own after every suggestion.
status.relearnToast: Learning again: it takes a couple of minutes

resetAll.title: Start over?
resetAll.body_one: The only correction from every project is forgotten and it goes back to the factory weights. Photos pinned so far won't count again; what you correct from now on will. Your manual levels don't change. A copy of what's deleted stays on the server.
resetAll.body_other: The {{count}} corrections from every project are forgotten and it goes back to the factory weights. Photos pinned so far won't count again; what you correct from now on will. Your manual levels don't change. A copy of what's deleted stays on the server.

levelsCard.title: How much each thing counts
levelsCard.intro: For every project, on top of what's learned. You'll see it in “Change photo” and in the next suggestion; photos already placed don't change. Each project can fine-tune it further in ② Photos.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: A test project, or one very different from the rest, may not teach anything.

stop.title: Stop learning from “{{title}}”?
stop.body_one: Its only correction is deleted and the app readjusts without it. A copy stays on the server.
stop.body_other: Its {{count}} corrections are deleted and the app readjusts without them. A copy stays on the server.

restart.title: Start over with “{{title}}”?
restart.body_one: Its only correction is forgotten, along with the photos pinned so far. What you correct in it from now on counts again. A copy stays on the server.
restart.body_other: Its {{count}} corrections are forgotten, along with the photos pinned so far. What you correct in it from now on counts again. A copy stays on the server.

events.title: Your corrections
events.intro: Every time you change a photo, the app notes “this one over that one”. If any was a test or a mistake, remove it.
events.showAccepted: Also show the shots you left as they were
events.removed: Removed: it no longer counts for learning
events.removeHint: Remove: it stops counting for learning
